title: Manufacturing and Trade: Inventories and Sales (September 2026 data) — the first combined business-inventories print on the restated wholesale basis, 10:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes, 1,135 table rows parsed across the 2020-2026 pages), row "Manufacturing and Trade: Inventories and Sales | November 17, 2026 | 10:00 AM | September 2026", release code A202611171000, reference A202609 — the 84th consecutive MTIS release on the archive this session rebuilt. Corroborated word-for-word on census.gov/mtis/index.html the same day: "Revisions to the wholesale estimates are anticipated to be reflected in the September 2026 MTIS release scheduled for November 17, 2026." Further corroborated by the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx PostedUpdates sheet, whose 2026-11-17 row reads "Retail sales + inventories, Import and export prices, Industrial production". Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep, and because Census's own restatement wording is "anticipated". Checked 2026-09-06
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-06 by this event's own initial research, after reading the single proposal that existed for this id (proposals/mtis-2026-11-17.from-mwts-benchmark-revision-2026-10-26.json, now shadowed and inert). Every claim in that proposal was re-derived this session rather than carried, and all of them survive. The identity, in one line: this is the edition Census itself names as the one where the 2023/2024 AIES wholesale restatement reaches the combined business-inventories series — so from 2026-11-17 both trade legs (64.9% of inventories, 69.1% of sales at June-2026 weights) stand on the new basis while manufacturers, 35.1%, is frozen by the M3 special notice for the remainder of 2026. The trap the proposal named reproduces exactly: a tracked entry already occupies 2026-11-17 and it is a different release — retail-sales-2026-11-17 is the 08:30 Advance Monthly Retail Trade report for OCTOBER data (A202611170830, reference A202610), while this is the 10:00 MTIS for SEPTEMBER data (A202611171000, reference A202609). Different hour, different reference month, different report; MTIS has never once printed without that 08:30 companion (84 of 84). Impact LOW and symbols empty on the same measured grounds as the sibling Census entries: no house playbook is macro-keyed (grep of trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md re-run 2026-09-06, 0 hits) and no instrument attaches. Date stays estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
